description: This PHP source file defines a class 'LeaveTypeMenuConfigurator' that implements menu configuration logic for the 'Leave Type' section within the OrangeHRM system. It customizes the screen context for leave type listing.

classes.name: LeaveTypeMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu options for the 'Leave Type' feature in the HRM system, overriding the screen to 'leaveTypeList'.

methods.name: configure
